title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Rules on Online Operation of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Online Operation Rules of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2022] No. 8

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Online Operation Rules of People's Courts were adopted at the 1861st meeting of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 30, 2021, and are hereby issued, effective as of March 1, 2022.

January 26, 2022

Online Operation Rules of People's Courts

To support and promote judicial activities such as online litigation and online mediation, improve the online operation mechanism of people's courts, facilitate the participation of parties and other participants in litigation, mediation and other activities online, and enhance the quality and efficiency of trial and enforcement work, these Rules are formulated in accordance with relevant legal provisions and based on the actual construction of smart courts.

1. General Provisions

Article 1 People's courts shall apply information technologies such as the Internet, big data, cloud computing, mobile connectivity, artificial intelligence, and blockchain to improve the information systems of smart courts, standardize application methods, strengthen operation management, meet the diversified judicial needs of the people through online means, and efficiently support trial and enforcement activities.

Article 2 Online operation of people's courts shall follow the following principles:

(1) Efficient and Convenient. Adhere to a people-centered approach, provide diversified dispute resolution and litigation services such as one-network processing, one-stop processing, and one-number processing, and alleviate the burden on parties.

(2) Focus on Practical Results. Integrate judicial rules, institutional reform, and technological change, improve information systems, standardize application methods, strengthen operation management, comprehensively support people's courts in carrying out online trial and enforcement activities, safeguard judicial work, and enhance judicial efficiency.

(3) Overall Planning and Sharing. Strengthen top-level overall planning, prioritize the construction and use of unified information systems for national courts, and continuously promote the compatibility and sharing of information infrastructure, application systems, and data resources.

(4) Innovation-Driven. Implement the strategy of building a strong internet country, increase efforts in researching and applying advanced technologies, and promote the advancement of business processes, litigation rules, and trial models with the times.

(5) Safe and Reliable. Collect, store, process, and use data in accordance with the law, protect state secrets, trade secrets, personal privacy, and personal information, and ensure the information security of online operation of people's courts.

Article 3 These Rules apply to the construction, application, operation, and management of information systems used by people's courts at all levels to support online judicial activities.

2. System Construction

Article 4 People's courts shall build smart court information systems, including smart service, smart trial, smart enforcement, smart management, judicial disclosure, judicial data hub and smart court brain, information infrastructure, security assurance, and operation and maintenance assurance systems, to ensure the online operation of people's courts.

Smart court information systems, with the judicial data hub and smart court brain at their core, shall achieve data interconnection and support collaborative handling of business.

Article 5 The smart service system shall operate on the Internet, securely connected to the court private network, providing the public with online services such as litigation, mediation, consultation, and legal education, and supporting the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system.

The smart service system includes the Online Service of People's Courts, electronic litigation platform, Mediation Platform of People's Courts, litigation service website, 12368 Litigation Service Hotline, electronic service platform, online preservation system, online appraisal system, etc.

The smart service system shall have functions such as litigation guidance, online mediation and roster management, online case filing, online payment, online evidence exchange, online entrustment of appraisal, online preservation, online trial, online enforcement, online file review, online archive inquiry, online service of documents, online announcements, and cross-regional litigation services.

The Online Service of People's Courts shall be integrated with other platforms of the smart service system and serve as the unified portal for the people's courts to provide online services to the public via the Internet.

Article 6 The smart trial system shall operate on the court private network or e-government network, providing trial personnel with online services such as file review, archive inquiry, hearings, trials, collegiate discussions, and adjudication assistance, supporting the construction of a modern trial system.

The smart trial system includes the trial process management system, electronic case file circulation application system, intelligent adjudication assistance system, sentencing standardization system, court hearing speech recognition system, etc.

The smart trial system shall have functions such as case information management, trial period management, real-time generation and in-depth application of electronic case files, intelligent recommendation of similar cases, assisted generation of documents, and sentencing assistance.

Article 7 The smart enforcement system shall operate on the court private network or e-government network, providing enforcement personnel with online services such as enforcement coordination, enforcement information management, locating persons and property, property disposal, and credit punishment for dishonesty, supporting the construction of a modern enforcement work system.

The smart enforcement system includes the enforcement command platform, enforcement case process information management system, enforcement investigation and control system, credit punishment for dishonesty system, judicial auction system, one-case-one-account case fund management system, mobile enforcement system, etc.

The smart enforcement system shall have functions such as full-process online handling of enforcement cases, analysis of enforcement leads, online investigation and control of enforcement property, release of judicial auction information, online price inquiry, and management of judgment debtors subject to enforcement.

Article 8 The smart management system shall operate on the court private network or e-government network, providing court personnel with online services such as administrative office work, personnel management, trial supervision, and archive management, supporting the construction of a modern judicial management system.

The smart management system mainly includes the office platform, personnel management system, trial supervision system, electronic archive system, etc.

The smart management system shall have functions such as online processing of official documents, personnel information management, trial supervision, and electronic archive management.

Article 9 The judicial disclosure platform shall operate on the Internet, providing parties, other participants in litigation, and the public with online public disclosure services for information on the trial process, courtroom activities, adjudicatory documents, and enforcement work that is subject to disclosure in accordance with the law, supporting the construction of an open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient sunshine judicial mechanism.

The judicial disclosure platform mainly includes the China Trial Process Information Disclosure Website, China Court Hearing Live Broadcasting Website, China Judgments Online, China Enforcement Information Disclosure Website, National Enterprise Bankruptcy Reorganization Case Information Website, and National Courts Information Website on Commutation, Parole, and Temporary Execution Outside Prison.

The judicial disclosure platform shall have functions such as information disclosure, information retrieval, and visual display.

Article 10 The judicial data hub and smart court brain shall operate on the court private network or e-government network, providing data and intelligent services for smart court information systems such as smart service, smart trial, smart enforcement, smart management, and judicial disclosure.

The judicial data hub and smart court brain include the judicial database, data management platform, data exchange platform, data service platform, artificial intelligence engine, judicial knowledge base, knowledge service platform, and judicial blockchain platform.

The judicial data hub and smart court brain shall have functions such as data aggregation and governance, sharing and exchange, correlation and fusion, visual display, knowledge generation, intelligent computing, decision-making assistance, evidence verification, trusted operations, and smart contracts.

Article 11 People's courts at all levels shall build information infrastructure to provide necessary basic conditions for the online operation of people's courts.

Information infrastructure includes communication networks, computing storage, general terminal equipment, and specialized facilities for important places such as information management centers, enforcement command centers, litigation service halls, and smart courtrooms.

Information infrastructure shall provide services such as computing operation, data storage, communication transmission, and display control for various application systems, data resources, and operation and maintenance assurance.

Article 12 People's courts at all levels shall build security assurance systems to provide network and information security for the online operation of people's courts.

Security assurance systems include identity authentication platforms, boundary protection systems, secure isolation and exchange systems, permission management systems, security management and control systems, and security operation and maintenance systems.

Security assurance systems shall provide security services such as host security, identity authentication, access control, classification and grading, cryptographic encryption, firewalls, security auditing, and security management for various information infrastructure, application systems, and data resources.

Article 13 People's courts at all levels shall build operation and maintenance assurance systems to provide operation and maintenance support for the online operation of people's courts.

Operation and maintenance assurance systems include quality and efficiency-oriented operation and maintenance services, visual management platforms, operation quality and efficiency reports, and emergency management platforms.

Operation and maintenance assurance systems shall provide operation, maintenance, and operation quality and efficiency analysis services for information infrastructure, application systems, data resources, and security assurance systems.

3. Application Methods

Article 14 Parties and other participants who use the smart service system for online mediation or online litigation shall first register and complete identity authentication, and obtain a dedicated account for logging into the smart service system.

When registering for the smart service system, the same user shall primarily use personal identity authentication and real-name registration, and shall use the same registration and identity authentication information as much as possible.

The smart service system shall be integrated with the public security household registration management system to support verification of user identity authentication information, and shall support unified management and shared application of user information.

Article 15 After completing registration on the corresponding platform of the smart service system, parties and other participants may log in online and pass identity authentication, and link relevant cases to participate in online mediation or online litigation.

Article 16 Parties and other participants may use platforms such as the Mediation Platform of People's Courts to conduct online mediation, including online application, acceptance, refusal or termination of mediation, and access to online mediation guidance.

People's courts, through the Mediation Platform of People's Courts and other means, support people's courts, parties, online mediation organizations, and mediators in conducting online mediation via computers and mobile terminal devices; support online pre-mediation negotiation and settlement, selection of mediation organizations and mediators, audio-video mediation, preparation of mediation agreements, application for judicial confirmation or issuance of mediation documents; support online procedural docking between litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution and between litigation and mediation; and preserve all audio-video and written materials during the mediation process.

People's courts, mediation organizations, and mediators may manage relevant organizational and personnel information online through the Mediation Platform of People's Courts and other platforms.

Article 17 Parties and their agents may submit online case filing applications through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts, electronic litigation platform, and litigation service website.

People's courts shall process online case filing applications and provide feedback on filing results through the smart trial system connected to the smart service system.

Article 18 Parties and their agents may view case litigation cost information online through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts, electronic litigation platform, Mediation Platform of People's Courts, and litigation service website, and make online payments through online payment channels.

People's courts shall issue payment notices and view payment status online through the smart trial and smart enforcement systems connected to the smart service system.

Article 19 Parties and their agents who fill in or submit electronic materials related to various cases online through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts, electronic litigation platform, Mediation Platform of People's Courts, and litigation service website shall comply with the requirements for format, style, standardization, and clarity of the corresponding documents notified by the platform.

Article 20 Electronic documents submitted online in compliance with requirements in the smart service system shall be automatically included in the electronic case file and transmitted to the smart trial system, smart enforcement system, and smart management system for circulation and application.

For case materials submitted offline, people's courts shall promptly generate compliant electronic documents synchronized with the case through scanning, re-photographing, transcription, and other methods, to form an electronic case file.

People's courts, through the smart trial system and smart enforcement system, support the circulation and application of electronic case files throughout the case, including file review, collegiate discussions, trials, judicial committee discussions, and cross-court file transfers.

People's courts shall use electronic case files to achieve intelligent applications such as datafication of documents, automatic backfilling of case information, assisted generation of documents, and automatic archiving of case files.

Article 21 People's courts shall verify electronic documents and data and other evidentiary materials submitted by parties through blockchain platforms via the corresponding platforms of the smart service system and the judicial blockchain.

Article 22 Parties and their agents may obtain information on technical conditions such as platform portals, communication bandwidth, and display resolution requirements through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts, electronic litigation platform, and litigation service website, and conduct online evidence exchange and online presentation and cross-examination of evidence.

Article 23 People's courts, through platforms such as the smart service, smart trial, smart enforcement, and judicial blockchain, support the determination and reproduction of the authenticity, legality, and relevance of evidentiary materials after the parties and their agents have presented and cross-examined them online.

Article 24 Parties and their agents may submit applications for online file review and online archive inquiry through the smart service system.

People's courts shall, in accordance with relevant regulations, retrieve corresponding case files or archives from the smart trial, smart enforcement, and smart management systems and transfer them to the smart service system, supporting parties and their agents in online file review and online archive inquiry.

Article 25 People's courts, parties and their agents, witnesses, and expert witnesses may, through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts, electronic litigation platform, and litigation service website, and in accordance with relevant technical conditions, conduct online video trials via smart courtrooms, computers, and mobile terminal devices, and carry out trial activities such as online pre-trial preparations, court investigations, court debates, speech-to-text conversion, and electronic signing of records. People's courts shall, in accordance with relevant regulations, preserve audio-video and written materials during the trial.

Article 26 Recipients of service may view, receive, download, and sign relevant served materials online through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts, People's Courts Service Platform, litigation service website, and China Trial Process Information Disclosure Website.

People's courts, through the smart trial and smart enforcement systems connected to the People's Courts Service Platform, shall record the electronic addresses of all participating entities, such as email addresses, instant messaging accounts, and dedicated litigation platform accounts, conduct online service of documents in accordance with relevant regulations, accept service receipts, and ensure full traceability of all information at every stage of online service, recording and preserving service documents.

Article 27 Parties and their agents may apply for preservation to the competent court, submit or supplement application information and materials, and pay preservation fees through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts and online preservation platform. They may also initiate online applications for lifting preservation, extending preservation, or reconsideration of preservation.

Parties and their agents may apply for guarantee from third-party guarantee institutions online through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts and online preservation platform. After the application is approved, they may pay the guarantee fee online, and may also cancel or change the guarantee online.

After the party pays the guarantee fee, the third-party guarantee institution may issue an electronic guarantee certificate online, supporting the party and their agent in viewing and downloading the electronic guarantee certificate online.

People's courts, through the smart trial and smart enforcement systems connected to the smart service system, shall conduct online preservation review and subsequent business processing.

Article 28 People's courts, through the smart trial system and smart enforcement system connected to the smart service system, shall initiate online entrustment of appraisal, selection of appraisal institutions, and transfer of appraisal materials ex officio or upon application by the parties.

Appraisal institutions may accept entrusted tasks online, review appraisal-related materials, and issue appraisal opinions or reports through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts and online appraisal platform. The appraisal applicant may view the appraisal opinion or report online, raise objections online, or apply for the appraiser to appear in court. People's courts may review and respond to objections or applications for appearance online.

Article 29 Parties and their agents may contact the people's court through platforms such as the Online Service of People's Courts, 12368 Litigation Service Hotline, litigation service website, and Mediation Platform of People's Courts for online consultation and inquiry regarding case mediation, trial, enforcement, file review, archive inquiry, petitions, service of documents, and information on reservation matters processing.

Article 30 People's courts, through the smart trial system, shall achieve real-time generation and in-depth application of electronic case files synchronized with the case, supporting intelligent cataloging of electronic case files, automatic information backfilling, online review and annotation, one-click archiving, transfer and review for appeals, and supporting the entire online process of case receipt, case assignment, trial, collegial discussion, adjudication, case conclusion, and archiving. By connecting to the judicial data hub and smart court brain, they shall provide intelligent auxiliary applications such as case data services, intelligent case analysis, precise recommendation of similar cases, and assisted generation of documents. They shall, as needed and in accordance with the law, achieve sharing of case file information and business collaboration within the court, between different courts, and between courts and collaborative departments.

Article 31 People's courts, through the smart enforcement system, shall achieve full online processing of enforcement cases, full traceability of enforcement activities, and comprehensive multi-level monitoring, supporting online implementation of enforcement measures such as property investigation and control, price inquiry and evaluation, auction and sale, distribution of case funds, and credit punishment.

Article 32 People's courts, through the electronic archive management information system, shall complete the collection, preservation, and provision of electronic archives online in accordance with archive-related laws and regulations.

Article 33 In accordance with the principles of legality, voluntariness, and reasonableness, parties and their agents may convert the litigation or mediation process from online to offline or from offline to online. The online operation mode of people's courts supports some participants participating in litigation, mediation, and other activities online while others participate offline.

Where litigation or mediation activities are conducted offline, the people's court shall promptly create electronic case files from relevant case materials and upload them to the relevant smart court information systems for management.

4. Operations Management

Article 34 People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with information security grading protection requirements, determine the security protection level of smart court information systems, develop security management systems and operating procedures, designate persons responsible for network security, and implement network security protection responsibilities.

People's courts at all levels shall, through security assurance systems, prevent computer viruses and network attacks, intrusions, and other acts that endanger network security; through secure isolation and exchange platforms, support cross-network information exchange while preventing cross-network malicious intrusions, unauthorized logins, data theft, and other acts; monitor, record, and retain relevant information system operation status and network security events; strengthen the security of critical information infrastructure operations; establish and improve user information protection mechanisms; and enhance network security monitoring, early warning, and emergency response capabilities.

People's courts at all levels shall carry out information system security assurance construction and assessment conforming to grading protection standards, as well as cryptographic application security assessment.

Article 35 People's courts at all levels shall ensure the security of data related to smart court information systems throughout its life cycle, and develop systems for data classification and grading protection, data security emergency handling, and data security review.

People's courts at all levels shall, through security assurance systems, establish mechanisms for data permission management in relevant information systems and for obtaining, analyzing, assessing, and providing early warning of data security risk information. They shall follow the principle of "security, necessity, and minimum scope" to achieve data sharing and security control, ensuring that personal privacy, personal information, trade secrets, confidential business information, and trial and enforcement work secrets in online litigation, online mediation, and other judicial activities are kept confidential in accordance with the law and are not arbitrarily disclosed or unlawfully provided to others.

Article 36 People's courts at all levels shall guide and supervise personal information protection in the construction, operation, and management of smart court information systems, accept and handle complaints and reports concerning personal information protection in online litigation and online mediation activities, regularly organize assessments of personal information protection in various information systems and publish the results, and investigate and handle illegal processing of personal information in judicial activities such as online litigation and mediation.

People's courts at all levels shall strengthen personal information protection in judicial transparency efforts, strictly implement the scope of disclosure as provided by law, disclose relevant information in accordance with the law, and use information technology tools to support the masking of sensitive personal information and quality control of judicial transparency.

Article 37 People's courts at all levels shall support the operation, maintenance, and guarantee of smart court information systems through an operation and maintenance guarantee system, in the form of first-line operation and maintenance, second-line operation and maintenance, and operational quality and efficiency analysis. First-line operation and maintenance is primarily responsible for user management, permission allocation, system fault repair, and emergency response handling. Second-line operation and maintenance is primarily responsible for monitoring and analyzing the operational status and quality and efficiency of information systems. The Supreme People's Court and High People's Courts at all levels shall regularly organize operational quality and efficiency analyses of smart court information systems and propose improvement suggestions.

Article 38 People's courts at all levels shall establish and improve a full lifecycle management system for information systems encompassing planning, project initiation, procurement, construction, testing, acceptance, application, and evaluation, achieving comprehensive management of systems and facilities such as smart court information system hosts, software, storage resources, communication networks, computer rooms, and dedicated facilities and venues, and supporting the stable online operation of people's courts.

Article 39 People's courts at all levels shall establish and improve process management mechanisms for the production, aggregation, storage, governance, processing, transmission, use, provision, and disclosure of data related to the online operation of people's courts, clarify data management responsibilities, comprehensively improve data quality, and enhance data application capabilities.

Article 40 People's courts at all levels shall develop contingency plans to promptly and effectively handle emergencies occurring during the online operation of people's courts, such as power outages, line disconnections, technical failures, cyber attacks, and data security vulnerabilities. When a fault cannot be repaired immediately, people's courts at all levels shall suspend the provision of relevant services based on the nature of the fault, promptly inform users of the fault information, until the system returns to normal, and record and preserve the fault information.

Article 41 People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with relevant legal provisions, cooperate with enterprises and institutions to advance the construction, operation, and maintenance of smart court information systems, support, organize, and supervise partner units to fulfill their obligations in accordance with legal provisions and contractual agreements, strictly implement management of partner unit personnel regarding access, on-site presence, work, training, security, confidentiality, integrity, and departure, ensuring that partner units do not take advantage of work convenience to arbitrarily alter, retain, use, disclose, or provide relevant work information to others.

Article 42 People's courts at all levels shall prioritize the promotion and application of nationally unified court information systems and advance the integration of locally developed self-researched systems into the corresponding nationally unified systems.

Article 43 People's courts shall, on the premise of meeting security requirements, strengthen on-demand connectivity and online business collaboration with external relevant information systems.

Article 44 People's courts at all levels shall actively publicize the significant importance of smart court construction to the public through various channels, promote and popularize the application of smart court-related information systems, provide training, consultation, and necessary application drills for various types of users, establish a mechanism for user satisfaction evaluation, tracking, feedback, and improvement, and continuously enhance the online operational efficiency of people's courts.

Part Five Supplementary Provisions

Article 45 These Rules shall come into force on March 1, 2022.
